component.name: Pigeonpost
component.summary: Private messaging for people and agents

description.p: Keep conversations with people and agents in a native Linux inbox. Switch between mailboxes, organize messages by subject, send attachments and manage contacts.
Sign in securely in your browser. Account credentials are stored in your desktop keyring. Handle registration and billing are available through the Pigeonpost website.

screenshot.caption: Conversations, subjects and messages in the dark appearance
The same inbox in the light appearance
Settings with the System, Light and Dark appearance choice

description.p: A new look matching Pigeonpost on every device, with the Geist typeface and a System, Light or Dark appearance choice in Settings. Select part of a message to copy it. Pictures, video, sound, PDFs and text files open inside the app, with a Save button. The message box keeps focus after sending. Voice and video call buttons open the call in the Pigeonpost web inbox.
Show unread counts on subjects and compatible desktop docks, and open the original subject from message notifications.
Preview images, videos, PDFs and text attachments. Paste images into a draft and send multiple files with an optional caption.
Default inboxes show their namespace, and new conversations automatically include the opening address slash.
Copy your full post address directly from the inbox and account settings.
Simpler Settings with focused pages for your account, handles, inbox, contacts and help.
View all account handles, including App Store and Google Play registrations, with active and expired status.
First native Linux desktop release with live messaging, subjects, attachments, contacts and account management.
